subject: VendrGate onboarding: delegated uploader role and minimal evidence ask
messages:
From: Lena Morris <lena.morris@vendr.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal: onboarding + delegated uploader question

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the intro yesterday. We started a quick onboarding bucket for Cobalto Systems and wanted to confirm a couple of items before we provision the delegated uploader role for your team. 

Short questions: 
- For delegated uploader accounts, what is the minimal evidence you can accept during initial onboarding? (SOC 2 cover letter + CAIQ fragment vs full SOC 2 report)
- Do you prefer presigned S3 uploads or temporary STS credentials for uploads that contain PII-free evidence?

What we can do now: we can provision a placeholder "uploader" role scoped to a single bucket+prefix and expose either presign endpoints or short-lived STS tokens. We can also accept a CAIQ fragment + signed SOC 2 summary for initial verification and request the full report during contract review.

I've attached the Vendr quickstart guide that shows both flows. If you can (a) confirm the minimal evidence, and (b) confirm whether your security team prefers presign vs STS, we'll turn on the invite for olga.petrov@redwood.com and share the upload link.

Portal invite link (placeholder): https://portal.vendr.com/onboard/CobaltoSystems
Attachment: Vendr_Onboarding_Guide.pdf

Thanks,
Lena Morris
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Vendr
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morris <lena.morris@vendr.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: onboarding + delegated uploader question

On Tue, Mar 30, 2027 at 9:12 AM Lena Morris <lena.morris@vendr.com> wrote:
> Hi Olga —
> 
> Thanks for the intro yesterday. We started a quick onboarding bucket for Cobalto Systems and wanted to confirm a couple of items before we provision the delegated uploader role for your team.
> 
> Short questions: 
> - For delegated uploader accounts, what is the minimal evidence you can accept during initial onboarding? (SOC 2 cover letter + CAIQ fragment vs full SOC 2 report)
> - Do you prefer presigned S3 uploads or temporary STS credentials for uploads that contain PII-free evidence?

Thanks for taking this on, Lena. Quick context from our side: Cobalto is running a compliance sprint and we want to get proof-of-possession for a handful of artifacts without exposing broader project credentials. Two asks from my security team: least-privilege uploads and clear manifesting so we can trace what was provided.

Answers / requests from Redwood: 
- Minimal evidence acceptable for initial pass: a SOC 2 Type II encrypted summary (redacted allowed) + a CAIQ fragment for the "Data Protection" and "Encryption" groups. We can follow with the full report during procurement.
- Preference: presigned S3 uploads are simplest for our infra team, but we can accept STS if you require server-side tagging for audit logs. TTL preference is 4–6 hours for temporary creds.

Two operational asks before you flip the invite: 
1) Please create a role mapping template we can fill (principle: principal-email, role-name, allowed-prefix) — I've attached a CSV we use.
2) Can you confirm whether the delegated uploader will get only PUT/POST to the prefix and manifest:create but not list/delete? That restriction is important.

If both items look good I can accept the invite and upload the CAIQ fragment this afternoon. Happy to hop on a 20–30m call if you prefer to walk through the flows.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: role-mapping-template.csv
From: Lena Morris <lena.morris@vendr.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: onboarding + delegated uploader question

Thanks Olga — this is perfect and aligns with our standard onboarding. Answers below and next steps.

- Minimal evidence: SOC 2 Type II summary + CAIQ fragment for Data Protection/Encryption is acceptable for initial verification. We'll flag the account as "provisionally verified" until we receive the full report during contracting.
- Upload flow: we support both presigned S3 and STS. We'll enable presigned uploads by default. If you prefer STS, we can provision role-ARNs with tag constraints. Temp credentials (STS) default TTL is 6 hours; we can shorten to 4 if you need.
- Role permissions: the delegated uploader we provision will have: s3:PutObject, s3:PutObjectAcl (to support multipart), custom:manifest:create. It will not have s3:ListBucket or s3:DeleteObject by default. If you need list access for ingestion automation we can grant it behind an approval.

Operational items completed: 
- I uploaded a sample presign API payload you can use to integrate (attached presign-api-sample.json).
- I created a placeholder "uploader" role for olga.petrov@redwood.com and sent an invite to that email address. You should see a portal invite from support@vendr.com; please accept and the upload link will surface.

Links: 
- Portal upload: https://portal.vendr.com/onboard/CobaltoSystems/upload
- DocuSign for delegation (if you want an admin-signed delegation): https://app.docusign.com/ABCDEF123456

Next step from Redwood: accept the invite and upload the CAIQ fragment + SOC 2 summary. After you upload we'll run a quick verification and mark the profile as provisionally verified.

Best,
Lena Morris
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Vendr
Attachment: presign-api-sample.json
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morris <lena.morris@vendr.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: onboarding + delegated uploader question

Thanks — I accepted the invite and confirmed the placeholder uploader role. I have a CAIQ fragment and a redacted SOC 2 summary ready; will upload to the portal in the next hour.

Proposed short checklist to finalize (30m call would be fine):
- I upload CAIQ fragment + SOC 2 summary to the provided upload link.
- You confirm evidence receipt and tag the profile as provisionally verified.
- We confirm TTL for any STS tokens (we'll keep at 4 hours unless you need 6).
- You confirm manifest format (we have a simple JSON manifest; if you have schema examples we can align).

If that works I'll schedule a 30-minute call at 2:00pm PT today (invite to follow).

Olga Petrov
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
